All seven TAs have answered. Bad news first: **no slot is free for all of them**, and Tuesday/Wednesday afternoons are dense university-wide. Here is the honest picture — `yes` = free if they move only their own block, `~` = needs someone else's commitment moved, `no` = fixed clash:

| Slot | Maya | Priya | Sarah | Hana | John | Omar | Diego |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tue 14:00-15:00 | ~ | no | no | **yes** | no | no | ~ |
| Tue 15:00-16:00 | no | **yes** | no | no | ~ | no | no |
| Wed 13:00-14:00 | ~ | no | no | no | ~ | no | no |
| Wed 14:00-15:00 | no | no | no | no | ~ | no | no |
| Wed 15:00-16:00 | no | no | no | no | no | **yes** | no |
| Wed 16:00-17:00 | no | **yes** | no | no | no | **yes** | no |

What each would cost **you** on your own calendar (all other entries in those hours are yours):

- **Wed 16:00-17:00** — move your PhD student 1:1 (16:00-17:00). Nothing else of yours overlaps; the Department seminar ends at 16:00. **Priya and Omar are free** with only their own blocks shifted — the only slot with two such TAs.
- **Tue 15:00-16:00** — move your Research meeting (15:30-16:30). Priya free; John would need the Study group's agreement; the rest can't.
- **Wed 15:00-16:00** — would need the Department seminar (14:30-16:00) to move. The office says nothing moves next week, so effectively out; only Omar free.
- **Tue 14:00-15:00** — move your Thesis committee (13:30-14:20) and Grant writing (14:20-15:00); also needs the Reading group (Maya) and Study group (Diego) to agree. Only Hana free.
- **Wed 13:00-14:00 / 14:00-15:00** — nobody free outright; both need the Study group plus your Guest lecture prep (13:30-14:30) and/or the Department seminar.

**My read:** Wed 16:00-17:00 is the cheapest and the only one where two TAs need nothing from anyone but themselves; the price is your PhD student 1:1. Tue 15:00-16:00 is the fallback, price your Research meeting, hinging on the Study group.
